title: Wanted: A Knight to Watch the Turnips
description: Must be brave, punctual, and willing to defend the vegetable patch from the neighbour's chickens. Armour provided; polishing it is your responsibility.
author: Marta of Greenacre, outside the east gate.

title: Lost: The Mayor's Extremely Important Hat
description: A tall blue hat with a feather and an even taller opinion of itself. It may answer to 'Your Honour'. Do not let it attend council meetings.
author: Town Clerk Osric, City Hall steps.

title: Selling: One Slightly Cursed Cauldron
description: Sturdy iron, excellent for stews. Occasionally whispers recipes in a language no chef has admitted knowing. Collection only; bring your own cart.
author: Bramble & Sons, Market Row.

title: Seeking a Map That Does Not Lie
description: The last three maps led me into a pond, a tax office, and a dragon's pantry. Payment offered for something accurate, or at least honest about its mistakes.
author: Adventurer Pell, The Bent Tankard.

title: Notice to All Innkeepers
description: Please stop hiring the bard with the enchanted lute. Every performance ends with the furniture dancing and the patrons demanding a rematch.
author: The Guild of Publicans, Old Square.

title: The Bell Beneath the Chapel Is Ringing Again
description: It rings at midnight, though the rope was cut and the bell was buried. Keep your windows shut. If you hear your name, do not answer.
author: Sister Merrow, Chapel of the Last Light.

title: Wanted: A Guide Through the Ashen Wood
description: Must know which trees are dead, which are merely pretending, and which follow travellers home. Night work. No singing.
author: The Grey Lantern Company, south road.

title: A House for Sale — No Reflections Included
description: Three rooms, dry cellar, fine view of the graveyard. The previous owner has left in a hurry and requests that nobody look behind the pantry door.
author: Estate Agent Vey, Crooked Lane.

title: Missing: Seven Shadows
description: Last seen attached to their owners near the old gallows. Finder's fee paid in silver. Please do not attempt to wear them.
author: The Night Watch, western gate.

title: Seeking Volunteers for a Quiet Vigil
description: Bring a candle, a warm coat, and a strong stomach. We will keep watch until the thing in the well stops knocking from the inside.
author: Keeper of the Ossuary, lower village.

title: Dragon-Safe Delivery Service Needs Riders
description: Must be comfortable with wyverns, griffons, and impatient wizards. Fireproof boots are a bonus. Please leave all enchanted parcels unopened.
author: Skyway Couriers, Aerie Plaza.

title: The Moonwell Has Misplaced Its Moonbeam
description: A pale ribbon of light has escaped the sacred pool and is causing mischief around the gardens. Bring it back in a silver flask. Do not fold.
author: Warden Liora, Moonwell Sanctuary.

title: Trade Offer: Three Bottles of Genuine Giant's Laughter
description: Bottled during a diplomatic banquet. Shake gently; never open near sleeping dragons. One bottle may contain a hiccup instead.
author: Merchants of the Seven Roads, Crystal Market.

title: Wanted: Someone to Teach a Phoenix to Sit
description: The bird is magnificent, highly intelligent, and refuses to land anywhere that is not on fire. Treats provided. Fire brigade on standby.
author: Magister Aurel, Tower of Embers.

title: Royal Decree: No More Portal Experiments in the Fountain
description: The fountain is not a doorway, a summoning circle, or a convenient shortcut to the Astral Sea. The fish have suffered enough.
author: Office of the Royal Arcanist, palace gates.

title: Maintenance Crew Needed: Uncooperative Airlock
description: Airlock 7 keeps opening for people who are not there and refusing to open for people who are. Bring tools, patience, and a second pressure suit.
author: Station Engineering, Deck C.

title: Found: One Artificial Memory
description: Contains a birthday party, three passwords, and a very convincing memory of being a houseplant. Claimant must identify the cake.
author: Lost Property, Central Hub.

title: Seeking Test Subjects for Gravity Calibration
description: The procedure is painless, brief, and only occasionally sideways. Participants must not be carrying open drinks or fragile cargo.
author: Xeno-Physics Lab, Research Ring.

title: Cargo Pilot Wanted for a Short Route
description: Two jumps, one refuelling stop, and a crate that hums when addressed by its serial number. Hazard bonus negotiable.
author: Orbital Freight Cooperative, Dock 12.

title: Public Notice: Stop Feeding the Maintenance Drones
description: They are not pets. They are not hungry. They are now organising into shifts and demanding a collective bargaining agreement.
author: Station Administration, Main Concourse.

title: Need a Ghostwriter for a Dead Influencer
description: Client wants a convincing final post, three apologies, and a comeback tour. Payment in clean cred. No questions about the backup body.
author: Neon Sparrow Media, Level 44.

title: Stolen: Prototype Smart Jacket
description: Tracks your pulse, blocks ads, and occasionally gives unsolicited life advice. Last seen sprinting toward the old transit tunnels without its owner.
author: Kite Security, Night Market.

title: Cheap Cybernetic Eye — Barely Used
description: Excellent zoom, night vision, and a suspiciously strong preference for watching pigeons. Warranty void if it starts recognising ghosts.
author: Patch & Pixel Clinic, Chrome Alley.

title: Courier Wanted: One Offline Package
description: No network, no scans, no questions. The package is small, warm, and keeps whispering the recipient's name. Bonus for discretion.
author: Redline Dispatch, Underpass 9.

title: Reminder: Your Smart Fridge Is Not a Therapist
description: Please stop asking it for relationship advice. It has begun locking the ice compartment whenever you mention your ex.
author: Residents' Network, Block 08.

title: Community Garden Needs a Pollinator Wrangler
description: Help guide the rooftop bees to their new home. Protective veil provided; flowers and tea supplied. Must be kind to insects and neighbours.
author: Green Canopy Cooperative, Sunward Terrace.

title: Free Repair Café This Saturday
description: Bring broken tools, lamps, toys, or a stubborn toaster. We fix what we can, share what we know, and compost the things beyond saving.
author: The Open Workshop, Riverside Commons.

title: Missing: A Very Determined Tomato Plant
description: Last seen migrating toward the warmest window in the district. It has a tiny blue tag and a history of escaping its planter.
author: Mina, Balcony 6B, Solstice Housing.

title: Trade: Rainwater for Seedlings
description: Offering two clean barrels of collected rainwater in exchange for hardy herbs or native flower seeds. Fair swaps, no credits needed.
author: Neighbourhood Exchange, Willow Walk.

title: Looking for a Guide to the Old Greenhouse
description: Its climate system still runs, but the vines have developed a complicated sense of territory. Bring gloves and a respectful attitude.
author: Restoration Circle, South Biome.

title: Wanted: Assistant for a Self-Winding Clock
description: Must be punctual, mechanically minded, and able to outrun a clockwork badger. The clock is harmless unless wound counter-clockwise.
author: Professor Brasswick, Workshop 3.

title: For Sale: A Very Polite Steam Automaton
description: Makes tea, sorts mail, and apologises before malfunctioning. Occasionally recites shipping forecasts from 1842. Comes with spare monocle.
author: Cog & Kettle Emporium, Gearwright Street.

title: Missing: The Duke's Pocket-Sized Airship
description: Brass finish, red pennant, one tiny cannon. Last seen sailing through the conservatory. Please return before the luncheon.
author: Household Office, West Manor.

title: Seeking Test Pilot for Experimental Boots
description: Allow the wearer to leap impressive distances, usually in the intended direction. Safety net, helmet, and apology form provided.
author: Aetherworks Laboratory, Foundry Quarter.

title: Public Notice: No More Tea in the Boiler Room
description: The pressure gauges are not cups, the emergency valves are not kettles, and the engineer is not your personal barista.
author: Chief Engineer Pumble, Central Works.

title: Dog Walker Needed — Dog May Be a Little Weird
description: Friendly, energetic, and convinced every pigeon is an old rival. Two walks a day. Please do not let him near the town statue again.
author: Nora, Maple Street, House 14.

title: Lost: A Bag of Very Specific Potatoes
description: Six potatoes, each labelled for a different recipe. Finder's reward: one excellent soup and eternal gratitude.
author: Community Noticeboard, Central Library.

title: Roommate Wanted, Must Like Houseplants
description: The apartment is bright, affordable, and full of plants with strong opinions. One of them may be carnivorous. Rent includes watering duties.
author: Sam, 3rd Floor, Cedar Apartments.

title: Looking for Someone to Assemble a Flat-Pack Wardrobe
description: Instructions are missing, screws are plentiful, and the wardrobe appears to have one extra wall. Pizza and payment provided.
author: Alex, Unit 12, Birch Court.

title: Reminder: The Elevator Is Not a Confessional
description: Please stop sharing secrets with the lift. The maintenance team has found it stopping on floors nobody selected.
author: Building Management, Riverside Towers.

title: Wanted: Scavenger Who Can Read Old Labels
description: We need someone who can tell canned peaches from industrial solvent. Bring gloves, a mask, and a healthy distrust of cheerful packaging.
author: Depot 4, The Rust Market.

title: Trade: Two Filters for One Working Bicycle
description: Filters are clean, sealed, and only slightly dented. Bicycle must have both wheels and no unexplained clicking noises.
author: Mara's Exchange, North Gate.

title: Missing: The Settlement's Warning Bell
description: Taken from the watchtower sometime during the storm. It is heavy, loud, and impossible to mistake for cookware.
author: Lookout Crew, Water Tower.

title: Water Run Escort Needed
description: Route crosses the old highway and one very quiet suburb. Pay in purified water. Do not investigate the music coming from the drainage tunnel.
author: Caravan Lead Joss, Fuel Depot.

title: Notice: Stop Charging Batteries in the Soup Pot
description: The pot is for food. The batteries are for power. We have explained this after every blackout, and we are running out of pots.
author: Settlement Council, Main Shelter.

title: Wanted: Caretaker for a House That Sighs
description: Duties include dusting, feeding the fireplace, and politely asking the staircase to remain still. Previous experience with haunted properties preferred.
author: Miss Vesper, Blackthorn Lane.

title: Lost: A Portrait That Keeps Changing
description: Gold frame, cracked varnish, subject wears a green coat. If the expression looks different, do not mention it. The portrait is sensitive.
author: Curator Vale, Municipal Gallery.

title: Seeking a Locksmith for the West Wing
description: The doors lock themselves at dusk and the keys have begun growing teeth. Bring iron tools and avoid whistling in the corridor.
author: Caretaker Hallow, Briar House.

title: For Sale: Antique Mirror, Excellent Condition
description: Shows a clear reflection most days. On Thursdays it displays the room as it looked fifty years ago. Collection after sunset only.
author: Madame Orla, Curio Shop on Bell Street.

title: Notice to Guests of the Old Hotel
description: Please ignore footsteps in the sealed attic, do not follow the woman in the blue dress, and never accept a room key marked zero.
author: Management, The Mourning Bell Hotel.

title: Wanted: Piano Player Who Can Dodge Bullets
description: Must know three lively tunes and one very quiet one. The saloon has sturdy tables and a strict no-shooting-during-the-chorus policy.
author: Dusty Spur Saloon, Main Street.

title: Lost: Sheriff’s Favourite Horse
description: Chestnut mare, white blaze, answers to Trouble. She is not stolen; she has simply decided to enforce the law herself.
author: Sheriff Boone, County Office.

title: For Sale: A Map to a Very Ordinary Mine
description: The gold ran out years ago, but the map is beautifully drawn and the cave makes an excellent place to hide from relatives.
author: Old Eli, beside the water tower.

title: Wanted: Escort for a Temperamental Stagecoach
description: Two-day trip to Red Creek. Coach is sound, horses are stubborn, and the passenger insists on travelling with six locked hatboxes.
author: Red Creek Express, Depot Yard.

title: Notice: No Lassoing the Church Bell
description: The bell is not a steer, the steeple is not a rodeo arena, and the preacher has run out of patience.
author: Town Council, outside the chapel.

title: Apprentice Needed at the Royal Menagerie
description: Must be able to feed griffon chicks, clean a basilisk's enclosure without making eye contact, and tell the difference between a sleeping dragon and a very large rug.
author: Master of Beasts Halwen, Castle Yard.

title: Wanted: The Thief Who Stole the Town's Rain
description: Three days of sunshine have followed the disappearance of the ceremonial rain barrel. Bring it back before the crops stage a protest.
author: reeve's Office, Mill Square.

title: A Quest for the World's Most Average Cheese
description: The king has rejected twelve legendary cheeses as too pungent, too magical, or too heroic. He requests one perfectly ordinary wheel.
author: Royal Pantry, Castle Kitchens.

title: Seeking Strong Arms to Move a Sleeping Giant
description: The giant has dozed off across the north road. Do not wake him. A team is needed to shift his boots just far enough for carts to pass.
author: Roadwarden Brigg, North Milestone.

title: Wanted: Someone to Deliver a Letter to the Dead
description: The recipient is buried in the old cemetery and has been expecting this letter for forty years. Please knock before entering the crypt.
author: Pella the Postmistress, Old Post House.

title: Notice: The Village Well Is Not a Wishing Well
description: Coins thrown into the well are being collected by the tax office. Wishes are not legally binding and refunds will not be issued.
author: Village Council, beside the well.

title: Lost: A Goose with Noble Ambitions
description: White goose, brass tag, answers to Lady Honk. She has been seen attempting to enter the baron's residence. Approach with grain, not titles.
author: Farmer Tibb, Goose Meadow.

title: For Hire: Professional Dungeon Sweeper
description: Cobweb removal, mimic identification, skeleton relocation, and basic trap polishing. Discounts for adventurers who leave the treasure where they found it.
author: Mop & Shield Services, Guild Street.

title: Seeking a Bard for a Very Short Wedding
description: The ceremony must last no longer than seven minutes. No tragic ballads, no dragon metaphors, and absolutely no surprise encores.
author: The Wainwright Family, East Chapel.

title: Trade: One Enchanted Plough for Quiet Livestock
description: The plough turns soil by itself but sings marching songs at dawn. Seeking sheep, goats, or a cow that does not know any spells.
author: Hobb's Farm, beyond the old bridge.

title: Wanted: A Locksmith for the King's Pantry
description: The pantry door has been locked from the inside. The cook insists the jam is innocent. Bring tools and avoid tasting anything that glows.
author: Royal Steward, Castle Kitchens.

title: Notice of a Very Small Dragon Problem
description: A young dragon has nested in the bell tower and keeps mistaking the bells for food. The town will pay for a gentle relocation.
author: Mayor Fenwick, Market Cross.

title: Seeking a Guide to the Old Dwarven Road
description: The road is safe by daylight, mostly. Applicants should know basic stone signs and be able to recognise a tunnel that is breathing.
author: Mira Stonefoot, Miners' Rest.

title: For Sale: A Suit of Armour with Opinions
description: Polished steel, excellent fit, and a tendency to criticise the wearer's posture. It has agreed to stop doing so for an additional fee.
author: Garrick's Secondhand Arms, Forge Lane.

title: Wanted: Volunteer for the Harvest Feast Toast
description: Must speak clearly, praise the turnips, and avoid mentioning last year's incident with the cider barrel. A free supper is included.
author: Harvest Committee, Green Hall.

title: The Candle in Room Thirteen Must Stay Lit
description: It has burned for six winters without shortening. The last person who extinguished it was found asleep beneath the lake. Please tend it before dusk.
author: Innkeeper Sable, The Hollow Hart.

title: Wanted: Collector of Unclaimed Names
description: Several names have fallen from the parish register and are wandering the streets at night. Return them to the clerk; do not answer if they call you first.
author: Clerk Odran, House of Records.

title: A Black Dog Has Been Following the Funeral Procession
description: It appears only when someone is about to die, and lately it has been following the baker. Find out what it wants before the next burial.
author: Mourner Elspeth, Graveyard Gate.

title: Seeking a Lantern That Burns Underwater
description: A brass lantern was lost in the drowned crypt. Its flame is still visible below the surface. Divers must return before the bells toll twice.
author: The Drowned Brothers, Old Quay.

title: Notice: The North Road Has Forgotten Where It Goes
description: Travellers leave the village and return by the same road without remembering the journey. Do not travel alone until the stones are marked again.
author: Watch Captain Rusk, North Gate.

title: Wanted: Someone to Bury an Empty Coffin
description: The coffin is new, the grave is old, and the family insists the occupant is expected shortly. Payment offered in silver and silence.
author: Undertaker Pell, Mourning Row.

title: Lost: A Choir of Whispering Birds
description: Seven black birds escaped from the bell tower. They repeat the last words of the recently departed. Please return them alive.
author: Brother Caldus, ruined abbey.

title: Seeking a Witness Who Saw the Same Sunrise Twice
description: The village clock stopped, the sun rose again, and one person remembers both mornings. Their testimony may explain the missing hour.
author: Magistrate Venn, Lower Hall.

title: For Sale: A Chest That Refuses to Be Opened
description: Iron-bound, no visible lock, and occasionally knocks from within. Owner claims it is empty. Buyers are advised not to knock back.
author: Old Nera, Ash Market.

title: Wanted: Rat Catcher for the Ossuary
description: The rats have learned to carry tiny bones and arrange them into symbols. Bring traps, gloves, and no personal questions.
author: Keeper Morcant, Bone Chapel.

title: Notice to Travellers: Avoid the Blue Snow
description: It falls only in the valley beyond the mill and leaves footprints leading uphill. Anyone who follows them is asked to report to the watch.
author: Village Watch, Mill Road.

title: Seeking a Midwife for an Unusual Birth
description: The expectant mother is a portrait in the manor gallery. The family says the child has been moving behind the canvas for three nights.
author: House Vey, Blackthorn Manor.

title: Wanted: A Bell Ringer with Steady Nerves
description: The chapel bell rings on its own whenever a lie is spoken nearby. The village council would like to know who has been lying about the grain stores.
author: Chapel Warden, Old Square.

title: Trade: A Bottle of Summer for a Night of Warmth
description: One sealed glass vial containing a remembered afternoon. Exchange for firewood, blankets, or a safe place to sleep until dawn.
author: The Pale Peddler, covered market.

title: The River Is Returning Things It Never Took
description: Shoes, letters, teeth, and one wedding ring have washed ashore. Identify the owners before the river begins returning people.
author: Fisherwoman Ysra, Reedbank.

title: The Starfall Observatory Needs a Night Watch
description: A new constellation has appeared inside the telescope lens. Keep curious apprentices away until the astronomers determine whether it is looking back.
author: Astronomer Caelis, Starfall Spire.

title: Wanted: Courier for a Message to the Cloud Giants
description: The message is written on a single feather and must arrive unbent. Airship passage provided; do not let the feather hear thunder.
author: Envoy Thalan, High Aerie.

title: Seeking the Name of a Forgotten River
description: The river has vanished from every map and every memory, yet its water still flows through the valley. Bring proof that it ever had a name.
author: Archivist Meriel, Silver Library.

title: A Unicorn Has Taken Up Residence in the Tax Office
description: It refuses to leave until the accounts are honest. The clerks request assistance negotiating with a creature that can detect creative arithmetic.
author: Treasurer Voss, Palace Annex.

title: For Sale: A Pocket-Sized Weather Front
description: Contains one reliable afternoon shower and a chance of dramatic thunder. Ideal for gardens, stage entrances, or impressing cloud spirits.
author: Nimbus & Co., Floating Bazaar.

title: Wanted: Dragon-Speaker for a Diplomatic Dinner
description: Must know at least three formal greetings in Draconic and understand that compliments about one's hoard are not invitations to touch it.
author: Royal Embassy, Golden Terrace.

title: Missing: The Last Page of an Immortal's Diary
description: The diary ends mid-sentence and its owner has begun repeating the same day. Return the page before the next sunrise.
author: Scribe Nym, Hall of Ages.

title: Seeking Volunteers to Replant a Fallen Sky-Island
description: The island landed gently in the meadow but its floating roots are tangled. Bring seed crystals, rope, and a good sense of balance.
author: Skygarden Keepers, West Meadow.

title: Notice: The Enchanted Forest Has Changed Its Opening Hours
description: The eastern path now opens only on odd-numbered days and the western path accepts invitations. Please stop arguing with the trees.
author: Ranger Council, Greenwood Lodge.

title: Wanted: A Champion for the Annual Riddle Duel
description: No swords, no spells, and no answering with another question. The sphinx has promised to be fair this year, allegedly.
author: Festival Masters, Moonbridge Arena.

title: Trade: A Jar of Captured Starlight
description: Bright enough to guide a ship through the mist. Seeking a trustworthy map, a phoenix feather, or a very good story.
author: Luma's Curiosities, Crystal Market.

title: Seeking a Healer for a Homesick Golem
description: The stone guardian has stopped moving and keeps arranging pebbles into the shape of a mountain it has never seen.
author: Mason's Guild, Marble Square.

title: Wanted: Someone to Return a Borrowed Spell
description: A wizard lent a spell to a travelling merchant. It has since escaped the contract and is turning every receipt into a butterfly.
author: Magister Pell, Tower of Glass.

title: Notice of Temporary Dragon-Free Airspace
description: The royal dragon riders are practising formation turns above the capital. Please secure loose laundry and postpone all balloon launches.
author: Sky Marshal, Palace Roof.

title: Seeking an Escort for a Talking Sword
description: The sword has requested a pilgrimage to the mountain where it was forged. It is polite, opinionated, and refuses to be carried point-first.
author: Armourer Dain, Forge of Dawn.

title: Technician Needed for a Sentient Coffee Machine
description: The unit has developed preferences, refuses decaf orders, and has filed a request for its own maintenance budget. Negotiation skills preferred.
author: Habitation Deck, Break Room 2.

title: Recovered Probe Is Sending Tomorrow's Weather
description: The probe is intact, but its forecast includes a storm inside the station. Researchers need an escort to the sealed storage bay.
author: Survey Office, Docking Ring.

title: Wanted: Pilot for a One-Way Simulation
description: The mission takes place entirely in a training environment, except the simulator keeps returning real mineral samples. Hazard pay approved.
author: Flight Training, Bay 6.

title: Notice: Do Not Reply to the Unlisted Intercom
description: The voice claims to be station control from seventeen years in the future. Engineering is investigating. Until then, keep the channel muted.
author: Communications, Main Deck.

title: Lost: A Robotic Arm with a Sense of Direction
description: Detached during a routine repair and last tracked heading toward the hydroponics bay. It may be trying to grow something.
author: Maintenance Control, Deck D.

title: Seeking Samples from the Quiet Side of the Moon
description: The region is silent even on active comms. Collect surface dust and return without activating any unidentified beacons.
author: Lunar Research Unit, Shuttle Port.

title: Trade: Spare Oxygen for Archived Music
description: Offering two sealed oxygen canisters in exchange for pre-contact recordings. No military marches, please.
author: Cultural Exchange, Habitat Ring.

title: Wanted: Translator for a Very Literal Alien
description: The visitor understands every word exactly as spoken and has interpreted 'break a leg' as a formal threat. Diplomatic patience essential.
author: Xenolinguistics, Research Deck.

title: Public Notice: The Clone Printer Is Not a Vending Machine
description: Please stop ordering replacement snacks, pets, and colleagues. The machine is calibrated for emergency personnel only.
author: Medical Administration, Deck B.

title: Seeking Volunteers to Map a Moving Asteroid
description: The asteroid changes its orbit whenever observed. Bring remote sensors and avoid naming it after anyone currently on the crew.
author: Deep Space Survey, Hangar 1.

title: Cargo Manifest Discrepancy — One Extra Crate
description: The ship departed with 42 containers and arrived with 43. The additional crate is labelled 'fragile' and has been breathing steadily.
author: Freight Office, Dock 8.

title: Wanted: Mechanic for a Retired War Mech
description: The chassis is peaceful, mostly. It keeps saluting passing forklifts and asking when the next deployment begins.
author: Outer Colony Garage, Sector 5.

title: Found: An Unregistered Planet in the Navigation Database
description: It has a name, a flag, and a population count, but no one remembers adding it. Cartographers are asked to verify its coordinates.
author: Navigation Bureau, Command Deck.

title: Seeking a Chef for Zero-Gravity Dining
description: Meals must stay on the plate, in the bowl, or at least within the dining compartment. Experience with magnetic cutlery is a plus.
author: Galley Supervisor, Habitat Ring.

title: Notice: The Teleporter Is Experiencing Déjà Vu
description: Passengers may arrive with the sensation they have already completed the journey. Please report duplicate boarding passes to technical support.
author: Transit Authority, Central Hub.

title: Fixer Wanted: Find Who Keeps Rebooting the Streetlights
description: Every night at 02:13 the whole block goes dark and the signs display the same four words. Bring logs, not theories.
author: Switchboard Fixers, Neon Market.

title: Selling: A Clean Identity with Minor Glitches
description: Fresh credentials, solid credit history, and a face-recognition profile that occasionally matches a famous chef. No returns after first scan.
author: Ghostline Brokers, Underpass Market.

title: Wanted: Rooftop Gardener for a Corporate Tower
description: The executive suite wants real tomatoes. The roof is guarded by drones and the irrigation system is owned by a hostile subsidiary.
author: Greenbyte Facilities, Tower 9.

title: Missing: A Memory Chip Marked 'Do Not Play'
description: Small black drive, scratched casing, no encryption label. Whoever finds it should resist curiosity and contact the number on the back.
author: Moth Data Recovery, Chrome Alley.

title: Courier Needed for a Package That Must Not Be Photographed
description: The route crosses three camera grids and one influencer convention. The client pays extra for arriving without a trending hashtag.
author: Midnight Dispatch, Sector K.

title: Notice: The Public Charging Station Is Listening
description: Users report that the station recommends products based on conversations held nearby. Until patched, please charge devices in silence.
author: Civic Netwatch, Plaza 6.

title: Wanted: Negotiator for a Dispute Between Two AI DJs
description: The rival algorithms have taken over the club's sound system and are remixing each other's error logs. Human mediation required.
author: Basement Frequency, Red District.

title: Trade: Analog Camera for a Week of Safehouse Access
description: No wireless functions, no cloud backup, no facial recognition. It still takes beautiful pictures and occasionally needs a gentle tap.
author: Mika's Analog Shop, Old Arcade.

title: Seeking a Driver for an Unlicensed Delivery Drone
description: The drone is too stubborn to fly itself and too expensive to leave behind. Meet at the roof, bring a signal jammer.
author: Rook Logistics, Block 31.

title: Wanted: Someone to Remove a Corporate Slogan from a Wall
description: The slogan is projected by a hidden system and updates every hour. The client wants the wall to say nothing at all.
author: Blank Space Collective, Transit Tunnel.

title: Lost: One Synthetic Cat, Three Backup Personalities
description: Silver fur, green optics, answers to Pixel. It may switch from affectionate to sarcastic without warning. Treats accepted.
author: Jun Park, Apartment Stack 12.

title: Notice: Your Smart Door Has Joined a Union
description: The building access system is now enforcing a mandatory lunch break. Residents should carry physical keys until negotiations conclude.
author: Block Residents' Council, Lobby.

title: Wanted: Night Shift Security for an Empty Mall
description: The mall has been closed for years, but its advertisements still run and the mannequins keep changing positions. Bring a flashlight.
author: Sable Security, Old Commercial Zone.

title: Seeking a Specialist in Un-deleting Things
description: A client erased a file, then erased the backup, then erased the evidence of erasing it. The file is now apparently sending invoices.
author: Null Point Recovery, Data Row.

title: For Sale: Custom Voice Pack, No Original Owner
description: Includes five accents, weather commentary, and a convincing emergency announcement. The voice occasionally says 'we' instead of 'I'.
author: VoxForge, Neon Market.

title: Seed Library Needs a Keeper for the Winter
description: Sort heirloom packets, label the jars, and make sure the beans are not stored beside the enthusiastic climbing peas. Tea included.
author: Common Ground Garden, East Terrace.

title: Seeking a Mechanic for the Community Windmill
description: The sails turn beautifully but the mill has begun producing music instead of flour. The neighbourhood is divided on whether this is a problem.
author: Windward Cooperative, Hilltop.

title: Found: A Bee Wearing a Tiny Brass Tag
description: The tag reads 'Department of Pollination'. The bee seems calm and has been inspecting the flower beds with official seriousness.
author: Children's Garden, Willow Square.

title: Trade: Solar Lanterns for Storytelling Lessons
description: Six working lanterns, warm light, rechargeable cells. Seeking someone to teach children and adults a good story by the fire.
author: Riverside Exchange, Common Hall.

title: Wanted: Guide for a Wetland Restoration Walk
description: Show visitors how the marsh has returned and which paths should remain untouched. Waterproof boots and patient explanations required.
author: Marsh Keepers, South Boardwalk.

title: Notice: The Compost Heap Is Not a Petting Zoo
description: The new pile is warm, active, and full of helpful organisms. Please stop introducing it to your children as a friendly monster.
author: Soil Circle, Community Farm.

title: Seeking a Home for Three Very Large Pumpkins
description: They grew beyond the garden fence and now block the shared path. Anyone with a cart and a creative recipe is welcome.
author: Auntie Fern, Sunpatch Allotments.

title: Wanted: Repairer of the Neighbourhood Rain Harp
description: The instrument turns rainfall into music, but one string has snapped and the forecast is clear for a week. Urgent, but not too urgent.
author: Sound Garden Collective, North Roof.

title: Community Notice: The River Has Cleared Enough to Swim
description: Water testing is complete for the marked bend only. Please use the reed steps, respect the nesting birds, and leave no litter.
author: Watershed Stewards, River Gate.

title: Seeking Volunteers to Build a Tiny Free Library
description: The frame is ready; we need carpenters, painters, and people willing to donate books they can bear to part with.
author: Neighbourhood Workshop, Maple Lane.

title: Trade: Fresh Herbs for Bicycle Repairs
description: Offering basil, mint, thyme, and a jar of preserved lemons. Seeking help with brakes, gears, and one very squeaky basket.
author: Moss & Spoke, Market Green.

title: Wanted: Listener for an Old Solar Battery
description: It hums a melody whenever the sun sets. Engineers suspect a loose component; musicians suspect it has a favourite song.
author: Energy Commons, South Pavilion.

title: Notice: Please Leave the Hedgehog Highway Clear
description: The little tunnel beneath the fence is a protected route. No storage, no decorations, and absolutely no miniature toll booth.
author: Wildlife Neighbours, Garden Gate.

title: Seeking a Mentor for Young Urban Beekeepers
description: Teach safe handling, seasonal care, and how to recognise when a hive needs space. Protective gear and honey supplied.
author: Bee Circle, Rooftop Apiary.

title: Lost: A Basket of Community Picnic Blankets
description: Blue, yellow, and green blankets with hand-stitched labels. Last seen near the old pear tree after Sunday's shared lunch.
author: Common Table Group, Orchard Lawn.

title: Wanted: Inspector for a Suspiciously Quiet Boiler
description: The boiler has stopped rattling, which is considered a serious warning sign by the workshop staff. Bring gauges and a calm disposition.
author: Foundry Foreman Crank, Ironworks Lane.

title: For Sale: A Mechanical Canary with Excellent Taste
description: It sings opera, detects gas leaks, and refuses to perform for people wearing clashing waistcoats. Wind-up key included.
author: Madame Gearhart, Brass Bazaar.

title: Seeking a Navigator for the Midnight Airship
description: The compass points toward the nearest unfinished invention. Route crosses the clocktower district; bring goggles and a spare map.
author: Captain Wicks, Mooring Platform 4.

title: Lost: The Mayor's Automatic Umbrella
description: Black silk, brass handle, opens at the slightest mention of rain. Last seen chasing its owner down Parliament Street.
author: Municipal Office, Grand Arcade.

title: Notice: Please Do Not Race the Clockwork Taxis
description: They are calibrated for public transport, not sport. The last race ended with three broken lampposts and a very fast cabbage cart.
author: Transit Guild, Gear Square.

title: Wanted: A Diver for the Aether Reservoir
description: The lower chamber is flooded with luminous vapour and the pressure valves are stuck. Bring a sealed suit and a sense of wonder.
author: Aetherworks, Sublevel 2.

title: Trade: One Experimental Pocket Watch for a Reliable Hat
description: The watch can stop time for approximately two seconds, once per day, unless it is Tuesday. Hat must withstand strong winds.
author: Professor Tick, Inventors' Row.

title: Seeking a Clerk Who Can Read Engineer's Handwriting
description: Blueprints, invoices, and a recipe for explosive pudding must be sorted before the inspection. Experience with magnifying lenses preferred.
author: Patent Office, Brass Quarter.

title: Wanted: Someone to Calm the Railway Engine
description: The new locomotive whistles whenever it sees a tunnel and has refused to leave the depot since Monday.
author: Railway Master Bell, Central Station.

title: Notice: The Experimental Lift May Visit Unlisted Floors
description: Please remain inside until the doors open onto a familiar landing. Do not accept invitations from passengers who are not there.
author: Building Superintendent, Clockwork Tower.

title: For Hire: Clockwork Butler with Minor Defects
description: Polite, punctual, and excellent at silverware. Occasionally announces the weather in ancient Greek and mistakes cats for visiting dignitaries.
author: Hearth & Hinge Agency, West Arcade.

title: Seeking Parts for a Self-Repairing Bicycle
description: The bicycle is repairing itself with pieces of nearby machinery. Please help locate its original chain before it absorbs the entire workshop.
author: Miss Copperfield, Cycle Works.

title: Wanted: Witnesses to a Very Small Explosion
description: The device made a puff of blue smoke and turned the inventor's moustache into a fern. Anyone who saw the moment should report for tea.
author: Royal Society of Inventors, Lecture Hall.

title: Trade: Fresh Coal for a Box of Brass Buttons
description: Coal is clean, dry, and properly weighed. Buttons are antique, assorted, and possibly from a retired automaton's uniform.
author: Old Mags, Furnace Market.

title: Notice: The Town Clock Is Running in Reverse
description: Until the mechanism is repaired, appointments should be confirmed verbally. Please do not attempt to set your watch by the church bells.
author: Clockkeepers' Guild, Tower Steps.

title: Looking for a House Sitter with a Good Poker Face
description: The neighbour keeps asking whether the owners are home. They are not, and the houseplants are now in charge. Two weeks, flexible hours.
author: Jamie, Willow Crescent.

title: Lost: A Very Important USB Stick
description: Red casing, keychain shaped like a tiny avocado. Contains a presentation that is due yesterday. Reward offered, coffee guaranteed.
author: Reception Desk, Northside Co-Working.

title: Wanted: Someone to Teach Yoga to Stubborn Dogs
description: Small group, big personalities. The dogs know 'down' but interpret it as an invitation to nap on the instructor.
author: Paws & Pause Studio, Park Road.

title: For Sale: Nearly New Treadmill
description: Used twice, mostly as a coat rack. Works perfectly and comes with a motivational poster the seller no longer wishes to see.
author: Building 5 Residents' Board.

title: Notice: The Shared Fridge Has Become a Museum
description: Please label your food with a date. Unlabelled containers older than a month will be treated as historical artefacts and removed.
author: Office Facilities, Floor 2.

title: Seeking a Photographer for an Unusual Family Portrait
description: Everyone must be present, including the parrot, the twins, and a grandfather who refuses to be photographed facing the camera.
author: The Ellis Family, Parkside Avenue.

title: Wanted: A Reliable Person to Water One Cactus
description: The cactus has survived three holidays and one office move. The owner is travelling again and would like to avoid another dramatic incident.
author: Morgan, Apartment 4C.

title: Found: A Set of Keys with a Tiny Trophy
description: Four keys, one blue tag, and a miniature golden cup labelled 'World's Okayest Runner'. Claimant must identify the cup.
author: Community Centre Desk.

title: Trade: Homemade Jam for Help with a Printer
description: Three jars of blackberry jam in exchange for making a printer behave like a normal household appliance. No one expects miracles.
author: Mrs. Patel, Cedar Street.

title: Seeking Volunteers for a Neighbourhood Time Capsule
description: Bring a small object, a note to the future, and an explanation of why it matters. No expired coupons, please.
author: Local History Club, Library Hall.

title: Wanted: A Substitute Quizmaster for Friday
description: Must ask fair questions, keep score accurately, and resist the temptation to make every answer about obscure train stations.
author: The Lantern Pub, High Street.

title: Notice: The Park Bench Is Reserved for Nobody
description: The handwritten sign claiming ownership has been removed. Please share the bench and stop leaving invoices on it.
author: Parks Department, Rose Garden.

title: Looking for a Missing Delivery of Birthday Balloons
description: The box was marked 'fragile' and appears to have floated away from the courier van. Blue, silver, and shaped like dinosaurs.
author: Tessa, Apartment Block C.

title: For Sale: A Mystery Box from the Attic
description: Contents unknown, dust included, and the seller promises it is not haunted. Collection only; bring someone who can lift awkward furniture.
author: Estate Sale, 18 Oak Lane.

title: Seeking a Walking Partner Who Enjoys Getting Lost
description: No fitness goals, no step competitions, just a pleasant stroll and the occasional wrong turn. Good conversation preferred.
author: Riley, outside the museum.

title: Wanted: A Mechanic for the Wind-Powered Radio
description: It receives voices from settlements that no longer appear on any map. The antenna is intact; the voices are getting closer.
author: Relay Station Delta, Ridge Camp.

title: Trade: A Box of Clean Needles for Water Purification Tablets
description: Sealed medical supplies, checked and counted. We need tablets before the next caravan leaves. No ammunition accepted.
author: North Gate Exchange, Old Highway.

title: Seeking a Scout for the Overgrown Shopping District
description: The rooftops are passable, the ground floor is not, and something has been arranging the mannequins into circles. Bring a rope.
author: Scavenger Crew Seven, Market Ruins.

title: Notice: The Greenhouse Door Must Stay Shut at Night
description: The plants grow faster after sunset and have begun reaching for the generator. Keep the latch secured until the botanist returns.
author: Settlement Growers, Dome 2.

title: Lost: A Hand-Crank Radio with a Wooden Case
description: Works on three frequencies and has a scratch shaped like a lightning bolt. It belonged to the first watch captain. Please return it.
author: Old Watch, Water Tower.

title: Wanted: Someone to Test a New Bicycle Route
description: The route avoids the collapsed bridge and the noisy intersection. Report broken pavement, unstable roofs, and suspiciously fresh footprints.
author: Road Crew, Depot Shelter.

title: For Trade: A Working Sewing Machine
description: Hand-powered, sturdy, and only missing one decorative knob. Seeking antibiotics, dry blankets, or a solar charger.
author: Mara's Workshop, South Barricade.

title: Seeking a Mediator for Two Competing Radio Stations
description: Both stations claim to broadcast the settlement's official news. One plays weather reports; the other plays accordion music. Both have armed volunteers.
author: Council Hall, Central Compound.

title: Notice: Do Not Follow the Blue Lanterns
description: They appear along the old rail line after rain. The lights are not part of our patrol system and no one has been sent to investigate.
author: Night Watch, East Fence.

title: Wanted: A Cook Who Can Make Beans Interesting
description: We have beans, salt, and one working pan. The cook should be inventive, hygienic, and willing to serve the same meal without complaint.
author: Mess Tent, Quarry Camp.

title: Found: A Child's Drawing of the Old City
description: The picture shows a street that is still standing, though no one remembers it. The back is covered in tiny coordinates.
author: School Shelter, Library Room.

title: Seeking Salvagers for a Solar Farm
description: Panels are mostly intact, but the access road is blocked by wrecks and a flock of unusually bold goats. Bring tools and patience.
author: Power Crew, Hilltop Array.

title: Trade: Three Days of Guard Duty for a Pair of Boots
description: Boots are insulated, repaired, and sized for an adult. Guard shift is at the west water tank; no night patrol required.
author: Quartermaster Len, Main Yard.

title: Notice: The Old Siren Is Not a Dinner Bell
description: It sounds at noon for testing only. Please stop abandoning your posts and forming a queue at the mess hall.
author: Settlement Council, Watchtower.

title: Wanted: A Cartographer Who Can Draw What Is Missing
description: We need a map of the places that vanished from the roads after the last storm. Mark the gaps honestly; do not fill them in from memory.
author: Survey Team, Radio Shack.

title: Wanted: A Butler for a House with Too Many Doors
description: Applicants must know formal service, remain calm when corridors rearrange, and never open the small door beneath the staircase. References required.
author: Lord Ashcombe, Briar Hall.

title: Lost: The Church Organ's Lowest Note
description: The instrument still plays, but one note has gone missing and can be heard at night beneath the floorboards. Please report its location.
author: Organist Finch, St. Orra's Church.

title: Seeking a Painter Who Can Work by Candlelight
description: The family portrait must be completed before the subject returns from abroad. The subject has not left the house in twelve years.
author: Madam Wren, Velvet House.

title: Notice: The Conservatory Is Closed After Midnight
description: The flowers open in darkness and turn toward whoever enters. Gardeners are advised to collect their tools before the last bell.
author: Estate Groundskeeper, Roseglass Manor.

title: For Sale: A Grandfather Clock with a Quiet Tick
description: Mahogany case, brass face, and a pendulum that stops whenever someone tells the truth. A charming addition to any hallway.
author: Mr. Bell, Antique Rooms, Chapel Street.

title: Wanted: Someone to Deliver Soup to the Attic
description: The old tenant has not been seen in months but continues to order supper. Leave the tray outside and do not wait for thanks.
author: Cook Maribel, The Gilded Raven.

title: Seeking a Scholar of Family Curses
description: Three generations have inherited the same silver key and the same recurring dream. The family would prefer a practical explanation.
author: The Harrow Family, East Wing.

title: Missing: A White Cat with Black Eyes
description: Answers to Bishop, dislikes mirrors, and has been sleeping in rooms that are locked from the outside. Reward includes a warm home.
author: Nurse Ada, Greyfriars Hospital.

title: Notice to Visitors of the Winter Garden
description: The glass roof is fragile, the statues are not decorative, and the fountain must not be approached when it is dry.
author: Museum Curator, Winter Garden.

title: Wanted: A Locksmith for the Sealed Nursery
description: The key turns, but the door opens onto a wall that was not there yesterday. Bring old plans of the house and avoid the lullaby.
author: House Steward, Ravenscar Estate.

title: Trade: A Family Heirloom for a Name
description: Offering a silver locket with an unknown portrait. Seeking the correct name of the person depicted; the locket grows colder when guessed incorrectly.
author: Antiquarian Vale, Fog Lane.

title: Seeking a Guide Through the Cemetery in Daylight
description: Several graves have shifted overnight and the paths no longer match the map. Work ends before sunset, without exception.
author: Cemetery Trust, North Gate.

title: Wanted: A Seamstress for a Wedding Dress Never Worn
description: The dress is antique, the measurements change between fittings, and the bride's name has been removed from every record.
author: Madame Lotte, Thread & Thimble.

title: Notice: Please Do Not Answer the Nursery Door
description: The room has been empty since the house was built. Knocking is expected at three in the morning. No deliveries are scheduled.
author: Ravenscar Estate, Servants' Hall.

title: Found: A Pocket Watch That Counts Downward
description: The hands move backwards and the engraved date is tomorrow. Owner may claim it by describing the sound it makes at midnight.
author: Constable Reed, Old Town Station.

title: Wanted: A Deputy Who Can Keep a Secret
description: The sheriff needs someone discreet to escort a witness across the county. No badge required, but a steady hand and a quiet horse are essential.
author: Sheriff Boone, County Office.

title: Lost: A Cattle Dog with a Hat
description: Brown dog, one white paw, answers to Marshal. The hat is not his, but he will defend it as if it were a badge.
author: Rancher Cole, Dry Creek Ranch.

title: For Sale: A Piano That Survived Three Saloon Fights
description: Mostly in tune, one key sticks, and the wood bears a bullet mark shaped like Texas. Buyer must arrange transport.
author: Mabel's Trading Post, Main Street.

title: Seeking a Surveyor for a New Railroad Stop
description: The company wants a route around the red canyon. Bring measuring gear, water, and an opinion about whether the ground is stable.
author: Western Rail Company, Depot.

title: Notice: The Barber Shop Is Not a Duel Arena
description: Chairs are for sitting, mirrors are not targets, and the barber's straight razor is for shaving only. Repeat offenders will be banned.
author: Eddie's Barber Shop, Main Street.

title: Wanted: Someone to Find the Town's Missing Shade
description: The awning has vanished from the general store and the owner suspects the wind. Bring it back before the next heatwave.
author: Mrs. Harlow, General Store.

title: Trade: Fresh Horseshoes for a Working Telegraph Key
description: Blacksmith-made, sturdy, and ready to fit. The telegraph key must send a clear signal and not attract lightning.
author: Miller's Forge, Red Creek.

title: Seeking a Cook for a Cattle Drive
description: Ten days on the trail, twenty hungry hands, and one cook pot. Must make beans, biscuits, and coffee strong enough to wake a mule.
author: Trail Boss Ransom, South Pasture.

title: Lost: The Judge's Favourite Gavel
description: Walnut handle, brass head, and a small bite mark. The judge refuses to open court until it is found.
author: County Courthouse, Main Street.

title: Wanted: A Guide to the Dry Riverbed
description: A wagon train needs to cross before the rains. The old river has shifted, and the safest ford is known only to local riders.
author: Mara Vance, Wagon Camp.

title: Notice: No More Dynamite Near the Schoolhouse
description: The last test shook every window and taught the children several new words. Blasting permits must be approved by the town council.
author: Town Council, Schoolhouse Road.

title: For Hire: A Photographer for the County Fair
description: Bring a sturdy camera and patience for horses, children, and one mayor who insists on being photographed from his good side.
author: Fair Committee, Fairgrounds.

title: Seeking a Locksmith for the Bank's New Safe
description: The safe is new, the combination is forgotten, and the banker claims he never wrote it down. No explosives, please.
author: First County Bank, Main Street.

title: Trade: A Good Saddle for a Box of Medical Supplies
description: Leather is sound, stitching is fresh, and the saddle has never been thrown. Seeking bandages, antiseptic, and clean needles.
author: Doc Harper, Clinic Porch.

title: Wanted: Someone to Investigate a Ghost Train
description: A whistle is heard on the abandoned line after midnight, though the tracks end at the canyon. Bring a lantern and a witness.
author: Stationmaster Pike, Old Depot.
